title: The Single Unit Rule
theory:
 When plural nouns are used after cardinal adjectives (One, Two, Three, etc.) to indicate
             a definite amount, weight, period, distance, they are treated as a Single Unit and take
             singular verb; if not used as a singular unit, plural verb is used.
